fields.name: workflow_type
fields.label: Workflow Type
fields.sourceQuote: This field is read-only. It identifies the type of workflow that you chose to edit.
fields.notes: General page, wizard page 1 of 3 (modal object under Workflows tab). Read-only display field, populated by the source workflow being copied.

fields.name: workflow_name
fields.label: Workflow Name
fields.sourceQuote: Type a new name for the workflow. This name does not have to be unique.
fields.notes: General page. Names need not be unique per the corpus.

fields.name: require_hardcopy_receipts
fields.label: Require Hardcopy Receipts
fields.sourceQuote: Select (enable) this setting if you would like Concur Invoice to match a physical image with an invoice and add a workflow step that will check for this match.
fields.notes: General page. CONDITIONAL-VISIBILITY DEPENDENCY: enabling this reveals the 'Hold for Invoice Hard Copy' step on BOTH the Steps page and the Step Rules page (administrator-experience-8b302852.md) — see dependencyCandidates. Corroborated independently by step-3-optional-select-enable-the-required-hardcopy-receipt-setting-c50e377e.md, which gives the click path 'Click Workflows (left menu)... Select the desired workflow... Click Modify... Select (enable) the Require Hardcopy Receipts option.' administrator-experience-8b302852.md places the same field 'on the Workflows page' (depth-collapse — do not treat as a second control). || SECOND-LENS RECORD FOR THE SAME CONTROL (same page, merged in assembly; its quote also verifies verbatim): Cross-cutting find: this control is documented in the IMAGE HANDLING guide's administrator-experience topic, not in the Workflows field roster. C7 depth collapse: this file homes the option on 'the Workflows page' while create-a-new-workflow-554e86aa.md homes it on the General page inside a workflow - one node only. Second, procedural source with an explicit click path is step-3-optional-select-enable-the-required-hardcopy-receipt-setting-c50e377e.md ('Select (enable) the Require Hardcopy Receipts option.'). Built page Image Handling already carries a cross-reference alternate to this field; Workflows owns it.

fields.name: approval_time_expired_action
fields.label: Approval Time Expired Action
fields.sourceQuote: Defines the action to take when an approver has not approved an invoice after the maximum number of days to approve has been reached.
fields.notes: General page. Value 'Send to Approver' Approver' is transcribed verbatim from the source (apostrophe placement as documented, an apparent SAP typo, not corrected here). Note under 'Skip to the Next Step': 'If the invoice reaches the step via a Timeout action, skip rules are ignored.' A daily scheduled job (Import/Extract Administrator tool) runs this action. b3d1bd2c.md ('About Vendor Approval Workflow Step and Timeout') describes what appears to be the SAME mechanism under different names, 'Workflow Step Timeout Duration' / 'Approval Action' — recorded as a contradiction, not a separate field.

fields.name: expire_after_this_many_days
fields.label: Expire After This Many Days
fields.sourceQuote: This setting only appears if the admin has selected an option in the Approval Time Expired field.
fields.notes: General page. Conditional visibility on approval_time_expired_action. Counted from the date the invoice enters the approver's pending queue.

fields.name: allow_timeout_extensions_for_this_many_days
fields.label: Allow Timeout Extensions for This Many Days
fields.sourceQuote: This option is only available if either the Approval Time Expired Action or Assignment Timeout Action options are enabled.
fields.notes: General page. Conditional on approval_time_expired_action OR assignment_timeout_action being set.

fields.name: do_not_display_skip_steps_to_employee
fields.label: Do not display the skip steps to the employee
fields.sourceQuote: If there are workflow steps that can be skipped, then the employee does not see that those steps are part of the workflow on the Approval Flow page in Concur Invoice.
fields.notes: General page. If cleared, a skipped step is displayed in parentheses to the employee.

fields.name: use_default_approver_at_or_above_current_level
fields.label: Use default approver at or above the current approver's level
fields.sourceQuote: If the employee is allowed to change the approver, limit the list of available approvers to select from to those with the same authorized approval rights as the original approver or higher rights.
fields.notes: General page. LABEL-DRIFT: using-the-default-approver-hierarchy-for-authorized-approvers-e977da80.md names what appears to be this same control 'Only display approvers at or above the current approver's level' — recorded as a contradiction (see contradictions[]), because a label-matching driver needs both forms. That file also states this checkbox 'pre-empts' the 'Restrict approvers to those with limit authority for employee-added steps' setting when used together with use_default_approver_lookup.

fields.name: allow_ad_hoc_steps_after_final_processor_step
fields.label: Allow ad-hoc steps after final processor step
fields.sourceQuote: Select this option to enable the user to add additional steps to a workflow following the processor workflow process.
fields.notes: General page. When selected, the Add button is removed from the approval step.

fields.name: email_employee_when_employee_added_step_is_complete
fields.label: Email employee when employee-added step is complete
fields.sourceQuote: Send an email to the employee when the step that they added has an action taken on it, such as approved.
fields.notes: General page. Conditional: 'This field is available only if you have chosen an option in the Steps Can Be Added field.'

fields.name: restrict_approvers_limit_authority_employee_added_steps
fields.label: Restrict approvers to those with limit authority for employee-added steps
fields.sourceQuote: When an employee adds a step in the workflow or edits a selected approver on the Approval Flow page within Invoice, then only display approvers marked as authorized approver based on limit of the invoice total.
fields.notes: General page.

fields.name: restrict_approvers_exception_authority_employee_added_steps
fields.label: Restrict approvers to those with exception authority for employee-added steps
fields.sourceQuote: When an employee adds a step in the workflow or edits a selected approver on the Approval Flow page within Invoice, then only display approvers marked as authorized approver based on exception level authority.
fields.notes: General page. Approvers qualify between the minimum/maximum exception levels defined on the Authorized Approvers > Configuration sub-tab.

fields.name: editable_by_groups
fields.label: Editable By Group(s)
fields.sourceQuote: Select the group rights that an administrator must have in order to modify this workflow.
fields.notes: General page. Only 'Global Group' is a documented, named option; other options are tenant-defined group-hierarchy nodes and not enumerable from the docs. Quote: 'If you select Global Group, then the workflow can be edited or deleted by any employee assigned to administer the Global Group.' NOTE: this exact label 'Editable By Group(s)' is ALSO used, per-tab, on the Approval Statuses (Invoice/Purchase Request) and Confirmation Agreements tabs — see approval_status_editable_by_groups, pr_approval_status_editable_by_groups, confirmation_agreement_editable_by_groups for those distinct controls; page-scoped names were kept unique per this validator's requirement.

fields.name: allow_employee_to_recall_payment_requests
fields.label: Allow employee to recall payment requests
fields.sourceQuote: Select this check box to let the employee recall an invoice after it has been submitted, but prior to extraction.
fields.notes: General page.

fields.name: skip_approval_step_if_approver_has_already_approved
fields.label: Skip approval step if approver has already approved
fields.sourceQuote: If the next approver in the sequence has already approved the invoice, elect to skip this approver by selecting this check box.
fields.notes: General page.

fields.name: submit_confirmation_agreement
fields.label: Submit Confirmation Agreement
fields.sourceQuote: If you use the Confirmation agreement feature, then, in the list, select the agreement that you want to use. The system displays the agreement that you select in the body of the Final Review/Confirmation windows that appear on submit actions.
fields.notes: General page. Value list is populated dynamically from Confirmation Agreements tab objects (see confirmation_agreement_name), not a fixed enumeration. || SECOND-LENS RECORD FOR THE SAME CONTROL (same page, merged in assembly; its quote also verifies verbatim): General page of a workflow. Consumes an object created on the Confirmation Agreements tab, so the agreement must exist first. No value list is documented - the list is populated by tenant-created agreements, which is exactly the kind of value this blind build must not invent.

fields.name: approval_confirmation_agreement
fields.label: Approval Confirmation Agreement
fields.sourceQuote: The system displays the agreement that you select in the body of the Final Review/Confirmation windows that appear on approval actions.
fields.notes: General page. Same dynamic-population caveat as submit_confirmation_agreement. || SECOND-LENS RECORD FOR THE SAME CONTROL (same page, merged in assembly; its quote also verifies verbatim): General page of a workflow; same tenant-populated list situation as Submit Confirmation Agreement.

fields.name: approval_request_notification
fields.label: Approval Request Notification
fields.sourceQuote: This notification is sent to the approver when the invoice is submitted by the employee.
fields.notes: General page. Selects among Email Notifications tab objects (see email_notification_name).

fields.name: status_change_notification
fields.label: Status Change Notification
fields.sourceQuote: This notification is sent to the submitter when the workflow status of the invoice changes.
fields.notes: General page.

fields.name: sent_back_notification
fields.label: Sent Back Notification
fields.sourceQuote: This notification is sent to the submitter when the invoice is sent back to them.
fields.notes: General page. NOTE: this notification 'is always sent; it is not configurable based on the user Profile preferences,' per the source's own follow-on note.

fields.name: allow_delegated_approvers_to_approve_own_requests
fields.label: Allow delegated approvers to approve their own requests
fields.sourceQuote: Enables a company to allow or prevent delegated approvers from approving invoices that they have created, on behalf of an Approver, or that they have created as an AP User.
fields.notes: General page. Corroborated by delegate-self-approval-1b627285.md.

fields.name: allow_self_approval
fields.label: Allow Self Approval
fields.sourceQuote: Allows an approver to approve their own invoices prior to submission, for example, an AP user can be added as an approver on their own behalf
fields.notes: General page. Gates both allow_self_cost_object_approval and allow_invoice_processor_to_process_own_invoices — see dependencyCandidates.

fields.name: allow_self_cost_object_approval
fields.label: Allow Self Cost Object Approval
fields.sourceQuote: Allows the cost object approver to approve invoices regardless of whether they are the owner of the invoice or not.
fields.notes: General page. 'This feature will only work if the Allow Self Approval option is also selected (enabled).' Also corroborated procedurally by self-approval-of-cost-object-based-workflows-20fd435d.md, which locates the field 'In the General step' (C6 wizard-vocabulary variant).

fields.name: allow_invoice_processor_to_process_own_invoices
fields.label: Allow Invoice Processor to Process their own Invoices
fields.sourceQuote: The Allow Self Approval option must be enabled (checked) in order for the Allow Invoice Processor to Process their own Invoices option to work.
fields.notes: General page.

fields.name: use_default_approver_lookup_to_find_authorized_approver
fields.label: Use default approver lookup to find authorized approver
fields.sourceQuote: The option is on the Workflows page (in Step 1) labeled Use default approver lookup to find authorized approver.
fields.notes: General page, referred to here as 'Step 1' (C6 wizard-vocabulary variant). Constraints per source: 'The workflow can only contain one Authorized Approval step when using this option'; 'The approver field for the Authorized Approval step should not be editable by the user or approver'; 'If user-added steps are enabled, they should not be set as Authorized Approval steps'; 'This feature does not apply to the Cost Object Approval step'; 'This feature works best with a flat (no levels) hierarchy.'

fields.name: step_order_column
fields.label: Step Order
fields.sourceQuote: To place the steps in the proper workflow order, use the Step Order column.
fields.notes: Steps page (wizard page 2 of 3). Sortable/orderable list column. 'You cannot reorder some of the steps' / 'You cannot reorder all steps.' (edit-and-reorder-workflow-steps-41535156.md).

fields.name: step_name
fields.label: Step Name
fields.sourceQuote: Type any alphanumeric name for the workflow step.
fields.notes: Add/Modify Workflow Step page, Steps page.

fields.name: step_role
fields.label: Role
fields.sourceQuote: such as Authorized Approver, Invoice Approver, Invoice Processor, Invoice Processor Manager, or Invoice Vendor Manager
fields.notes: Add/Modify Workflow Step page. 'System' role is inferred from 'If this is System, then the step is fully automated' — same sentence names all six values collectively (five non-system roles plus System). Corroborated by default-workflows-a6fa157a.md, which uses the same Role values in its default-step catalog (Employee, Invoice Approver, Invoice Processor, Invoice Vendor Manager (a System role), System) — 'Employee' there is the invoice submitter, not a selectable Role option per this file's own text, so it is NOT added to validValues (thin/honest gap, not invented). 'If you select Authorized Approver, two check boxes appear...' — see dependencyCandidates. || SECOND-LENS RECORD FOR THE SAME CONTROL (same page, merged in assembly; its quote also verifies verbatim): Add Workflow Step page. OPEN LIST - the source hedges with 'such as', so do not treat these six as closed. A DIFFERENT role set appears in the shipped default-workflow tables including 'Employee', which is absent here - see contradictions. Selecting Authorized Approver reveals two limit/exception check boxes and, per step-1-assign-the-level-to-the-workflow-step-6035f10a.md, the Authorized Approver Level field.

fields.name: step_initial_status
fields.label: Initial Status
fields.sourceQuote: Click an approval status that represents what the invoice status should be set to when the Step begins, such as Pending Approval.
fields.notes: Add/Modify Workflow Step page. Populated from Approval Statuses tab objects — see valueSetCandidates (default_approval_statuses_list) for the documented default status set; custom statuses can also be created. || SECOND-LENS RECORD FOR THE SAME CONTROL (same page, merged in assembly; its quote also verifies verbatim): Add Workflow Step page. The selectable set = the 13 default approval statuses (default-approval-statuses-34c83d58.md, emitted as a valueSetCandidate) PLUS any custom statuses created on the Approval Statuses tab. Custom statuses drive a documented jump: the engine looks for the next step carrying that custom status as its Initial Status and skips to it, otherwise it behaves as a normal approval step.

fields.name: step_approval_actions
fields.label: Approval Actions
fields.sourceQuote: From the Approval Actions helper pane, click an action that an approver can make to an invoice that is awaiting approval.
fields.notes: Add/Modify Workflow Step page. NOT enumerated in this file. Explicitly distinguished from the Step-Rules action catalog: 'These approval actions are different from the Workflow rule approval actions... There are five standard approval actions for workflow rules: generate an exception, send an email, send back to employee, skip this step, and change approver.' Thin — the approver-facing action list (e.g. approve/reject) is not itself enumerated anywhere in this file set. || SECOND-LENS RECORD FOR THE SAME CONTROL (same page, merged in assembly; its quote also verifies verbatim): Add Workflow Step page. Populated from a helper pane, so the corpus never enumerates it - validValues empty is the correct answer here. EXPLICITLY DISTINCT from the five workflow-RULE actions; the source says so in a Note. Multi-select for approver roles, single-select when Role is System.

fields.name: step_can_exit_with_blocking_exceptions
fields.label: Can exit step with blocking exceptions
fields.sourceQuote: Toggle (disable) this check box to block the invoice from progressing past approval in workflow.
fields.notes: Add/Modify Workflow Step page. || SECOND-LENS RECORD FOR THE SAME CONTROL (same page, merged in assembly; its quote also verifies verbatim): Add Workflow Step page, final row of 8. The source says 'Toggle (disable)' - the control is described ONLY in its disabling direction; the enabled semantics are not stated and must not be inferred.

fields.name: step_rule_name
fields.label: Name
fields.sourceQuote: Type any alphanumeric name for the workflow rule. The name does not have to be unique.
fields.notes: Edit Condition window, Step Rules page (wizard page 3 of 3).

fields.name: step_rule_force_evaluation
fields.label: Force Evaluation
fields.sourceQuote: If the check box is _not_ selected, then the rule is evaluated and executed only if all other rules in this step were determined to be false.
fields.notes: Edit Condition window, Step Rules page. Controls whether all step rules are always evaluated vs. short-circuit evaluation.

fields.name: step_rule_action_name
fields.label: Action Name
fields.sourceQuote: From the Action Name list, select the desired action.
fields.notes: Edit Action window, Step Rules page. 'A single workflow rule can contain only one of these actions: Skip step, Change approver, Send back to employee.' 'A workflow rule can contain multiple instances of these actions: Generate an exception, Send email.' Cardinality constraint is documented (compressedRanges not applicable — this is an enumerated exclusivity rule, not a compressed range).

fields.name: step_rule_change_approver_select
fields.label: Change Approver (Select an approver)
fields.sourceQuote: Routes the invoice to another approver when the conditions are met.
fields.notes: Edit Action window field for the Change Approver action.

fields.name: step_rule_generate_exception_select
fields.label: Generate Exception (Select an exception)
fields.sourceQuote: Select an exception from the helper pane or create a new one.
fields.notes: Edit Action window field for the Generate Exception action.

fields.name: step_rule_send_email_designated_recipient
fields.label: Send Email (designated recipient)
fields.sourceQuote: Sends an email notification to an employee designated here. The administrator can supply who receives the email, what Subject line and text displays.
fields.notes: Edit Action window field for the Send Email action.

fields.name: step_rule_skip_step_message
fields.label: Message
fields.sourceQuote: Type a message in the Message field.
fields.notes: Edit Action window field for the Skip Step action.

fields.name: workflow_condition_left_parenthesis
fields.label: A: Left Parenthesis
fields.sourceQuote: Select zero to three parentheses, depending on the complexity of the condition.
fields.notes: Condition page (Step Rules > New rule > Edit Condition), WORKFLOWS-side condition editor. 'The Condition page in the Workflows tool is similar to the Condition Editor page used in the Audit Rules tool and Expense Processor.' DEDUPE ON FILES not fields: this file is cited by zero graph fields today; the-condition-page-5d4ea870.md (Audit Rules side, already mined) is a DIFFERENT file and not re-mined here. Field names given page-scoped prefixes to avoid name collision with any Audit Rules field of the same conceptual role.

fields.name: workflow_condition_data_object_b
fields.label: B: Data Object
fields.sourceQuote: The choices that appear in this list are based on the event that triggers the rule:
fields.notes: Condition page. 7-entry Data Object list, complete as enumerated in the source.

fields.name: workflow_condition_field_value_c
fields.label: C: Field/Value
fields.sourceQuote: Select an item from the helper pane that appears. The information that appears in this pane is based upon the selection made in the Data Object list.
fields.notes: Condition page. Content depends on workflow_condition_data_object_b selection; a partial catalog for the Employee and Request data objects is given as a separate value set — see valueSetCandidates.

fields.name: workflow_condition_data_object_e
fields.label: E: Data Object
fields.sourceQuote: The system provides the option that best suits the previous choices. Change it if necessary.
fields.notes: Condition page. Second occurrence of a Data Object selector within one condition row; presumed to share the same 7-entry value set as column B, though the source does not restate the list for column E.

fields.name: workflow_condition_field_value_f
fields.label: F: Field/Value
fields.sourceQuote: Select an item from the helper pane that appears. The information that appears in this pane is based upon the selection made in the Data Object list.
fields.notes: Condition page.

fields.name: workflow_condition_right_parenthesis_g
fields.label: G: Right Parenthesis
fields.sourceQuote: Select zero to three parentheses, depending on the complexity of the condition.
fields.notes: Condition page.

fields.name: workflow_condition_and_or_h
fields.label: H: And/Or
fields.sourceQuote: Select either option to join the current condition to the next condition; this line appears when there are multiple conditions, and only between conditions, never after the final condition.
fields.notes: Condition page. Two implied options (And / Or), not separately enumerated as a bulleted list in this file — left validValues empty per the thin-is-correct rule since the two option strings themselves are not quoted verbatim as a discrete list.

fields.name: authorized_approver_feature_available_for_workflows
fields.label: Authorized Approver feature is available for workflows
fields.sourceQuote: To activate the feature, select Authorized Approver feature is available for workflows.
fields.notes: Authorized Approvers > Configuration sub-tab. Gates the whole Authorized-Approver-based ad hoc restriction UI (understand-ad-hoc-steps-ce0af3e7.md) — see dependencyCandidates.

fields.name: minimum_exception_level
fields.label: Minimum Exception Level
fields.sourceQuote: Enter the minimum exception level that authorized approvers can approve.
fields.notes: Authorized Approvers > Configuration sub-tab. Resolves unresolved endpoint dep.g2ar.024/dep.g2ar.026 'exception_level_limit'. || SECOND-LENS RECORD FOR THE SAME CONTROL (same page, merged in assembly; its quote also verifies verbatim): Authorized Approvers > Configuration sub-tab. Pairs with Maximum Exception Level to define exception-based approval authority (authorized-approvers-overview-8b3bd2d0.md: 'the administrator defines a minimum and maximum exception level'). Likely the resolution for unresolved endpoints dep.g2ar.024 / dep.g2ar.026 ('exception_level_limit'). No numeric range is documented for these two fields - do NOT borrow the 'one to 99' range from the Settings-tab exception-level controls.

fields.name: maximum_exception_level
fields.label: Maximum Exception Level
fields.sourceQuote: Enter the maximum exception level that authorized approvers can approve.
fields.notes: Authorized Approvers > Configuration sub-tab. Corroborated by configuration-8b3be88b.md: 'The range is set in Administration > Invoice > Workflows > Authorized Approver tab.' || SECOND-LENS RECORD FOR THE SAME CONTROL (same page, merged in assembly; its quote also verifies verbatim): Authorized Approvers > Configuration sub-tab. See Minimum Exception Level. No documented range.

fields.name: authorized_approver_list_approver
fields.label: Approver
fields.sourceQuote: Select an approver.
fields.notes: Authorized Approvers > Authorized Approver List sub-tab, New/Modify Authorized Approver window.

fields.name: authorized_approver_can_approve_exception
fields.label: Can approve exception
fields.sourceQuote: Select the check box to give this authorized approver exception approval.
fields.notes: Authorized Approvers > Authorized Approver List sub-tab, New/Modify Authorized Approver window.

fields.name: authorized_approver_approval_limit
fields.label: Approval Limit
fields.sourceQuote: If you want this authorized approver to have limit approval, select the currency and the amount.
fields.notes: Authorized Approvers > Authorized Approver List sub-tab. SPECIAL VALUES documented: 'You can enter 0 in the Approval Limit field. This puts the approver into the authorized approver workflow but will prevent that approver from having final authority to approve the invoice.' A blank amount with 'no approval limit' currency yields unlimited approval — corroborated by setting-an-unlimited-approval-amount-9d98b489.md: 'a limit amount of null will result in an unlimited approval/no limit approval amount.'

fields.name: authorized_approver_level
fields.label: Level
fields.sourceQuote: The Level field appears if levels have been assigned to a workflow approval step.
fields.notes: Authorized Approvers > Authorized Approver List sub-tab, New/Modify Authorized Approver window. Conditional visibility on step_authorized_approver_level being assigned to a workflow step first — see dependencyCandidates. Each hierarchy section accepts only one level per user (filter-authorized-approvers-by-workflow-approval-step-aae69350.md: 'Each section of the authorized approver hierarchy will accept only one level per user, so each level must be assigned at different sections of the hierarchy.'). Can also be assigned via record type 720 in the employee import (step-2-assign-the-level-to-the-approver-d8bf669c.md).

fields.name: step_authorized_approver_level
fields.label: Authorized Approver Level
fields.sourceQuote: The Authorized Approver Level field appears only if the Authorized Approver option is selected in the Role field.
fields.notes: Add/Modify Workflow Step page. Full click path: 'Click Administration > Invoice > Workflows (left menu)... double-click the desired workflow... Select the Steps page... Double-click the desired workflow step.' See also 'level' feature narrative in filter-authorized-approvers-by-workflow-approval-step-aae69350.md.

fields.name: step_restrict_approvers_limit_authority_checkbox
fields.label: Restrict approvers to those with limit authority
fields.sourceQuote: Select Restrict approvers to those with limit authority to limit the type of authorized approver.
fields.notes: Add Workflow Step window, appears when step_role = Authorized Approver. LABEL-DRIFT candidate against the General-page 'Restrict approvers to those with limit authority for employee-added steps' — this Steps-page instance drops the 'for employee-added steps' qualifier; the source itself distinguishes them by context (per-step vs employee-added-step), so recorded as a distinct field rather than a forced contradiction.

fields.name: step_restrict_approvers_exception_authority_checkbox
fields.label: Restrict approvers to those with exception authority
fields.sourceQuote: Select Restrict approvers to those with exception authority to limit the type of authorized approver.
fields.notes: Add Workflow Step window, appears when step_role = Authorized Approver. 'If neither of these is checked, any approver may be used for the step, but the limit-approved or exception-approved indicator will be set only if the approver is authorized.'

fields.name: approval_status_status
fields.label: Status
fields.sourceQuote: Type a name for the new status.
fields.notes: Approval Statuses > Invoice sub-tab, Request Status window. Value set of DEFAULT status names is documented separately — see valueSetCandidates (default_approval_statuses_list).

fields.name: approval_status_action_text
fields.label: Action Text
fields.sourceQuote: Type descriptive text to be used as the action text. This text becomes button text for the approver.
fields.notes: Approval Statuses > Invoice sub-tab, Request Status window. Becomes the on-screen button label for the approver.

fields.name: approval_status_description
fields.label: Description
fields.sourceQuote: Type the description text.
fields.notes: Approval Statuses > Invoice sub-tab, Request Status window.

fields.name: approval_status_editable_by_groups
fields.label: Editable By Group(s)
fields.sourceQuote: Select the group configuration(s) that can edit this workflow.
fields.notes: Approval Statuses > Invoice sub-tab. Same label text as the General-page editable_by_groups field and the Confirmation Agreements editable-by field — a genuinely repeated per-tab UI pattern, not a contradiction; kept as a distinct machine name to satisfy per-page name uniqueness.

fields.name: pr_approval_status_status
fields.label: Status
fields.sourceQuote: Type a name for the new status.
fields.notes: Approval Statuses > Purchase Request sub-tab, Report Status window. Sub-tab twin of approval_status_status — 'Click Approval Statuses tab, and then the Purchase Request tab... clicking Administration > Invoice > Workflows > Approval Statuses > Purchase Request'. Field NOT deduped away per the map-phase instruction ('Do not dedupe it away as a repeat') because it is independent sub-tab evidence.

fields.name: pr_approval_status_action_text
fields.label: Action Text
fields.sourceQuote: Type descriptive text to be used as the action text. This text becomes button text for the approver. When the approver clicks the button, the purchase request approval status changes to this approval status.
fields.notes: Approval Statuses > Purchase Request sub-tab.

fields.name: pr_approval_status_description
fields.label: Description
fields.sourceQuote: Type the description text.
fields.notes: Approval Statuses > Purchase Request sub-tab.

fields.name: pr_approval_status_editable_by_groups
fields.label: Editable By Group(s)
fields.sourceQuote: Select the group configuration(s) that can edit this workflow.
fields.notes: Approval Statuses > Purchase Request sub-tab.

fields.name: email_notification_name
fields.label: Email Notification Name
fields.sourceQuote: The name of the email notification. This name will appear in the email notification list while editing the workflow.
fields.notes: Email Notifications tab, Modify Email Notification window (General step). One of only two fields editable on a fresh Copy — see add-an-email-notification-c237a2de.md. || SECOND-LENS RECORD FOR THE SAME CONTROL (same page, merged in assembly; its quote also verifies verbatim): Email Notifications tab, General step of the Modify Email Notification window. One of only TWO fields editable on a freshly copied notification - the add flow is Copy-then-edit, there is no create-from-scratch.

fields.name: email_notification_type
fields.label: Notification Type
fields.sourceQuote: The Payment notification type is displayed.
fields.notes: Email Notifications tab, Modify Email Notification window. Read-only display, not an enumerated selectable list per this source. || SECOND-LENS RECORD FOR THE SAME CONTROL (same page, merged in assembly; its quote also verifies verbatim): Email Notifications tab. DISPLAY-ONLY as documented; only the value 'Payment' is ever named and no selectable list is enumerated, so validValues stays empty.

fields.name: email_notification_display_as_from
fields.label: Display as From
